summary: Frontend regression verification of the hidden-iframe print fix for /kitchen (previous @media print CSS deletion caused blank thermal receipts). Tested end-to-end against the real preview URL. RESULTS: (1) Kitchen login cuisine@burgertimes.fr redirects to /kitchen OK. (2) A live test order created via /api/checkout/session appeared in the 'Nouvelles' tab within the 4s polling window (~<6s). (3) 'Activer le son' click removes the button with zero console errors. (4) Clicking 'Accepter & Imprimer' triggered the new printKitchenReceipt() flow: a spy on HTMLBodyElement.prototype.appendChild + removeChild recorded exactly 1 iframe appended and 1 iframe removed on the body, ZERO console errors, ZERO page errors, ZERO unhandled exceptions; the order transitioned from Nouvelles -> Acceptées and the kitchen-print-badge rendered as "En attente d'impression" (yellow Clock). Since KITCHEN_PRINT_ENDPOINT is unset in this env, the backend does not upgrade status to 'printed' automatically — the 'En attente' badge is the expected value while the SUNMI/Android bridge is not configured, matching iteration_15 behavior. (5) 'Réimprimer' on the Acceptées tab reproduces exactly the same iframe append+remove pair with no console errors, and the order stays in Acceptées (status unchanged). (6) Declining a second order with a reason moves it to Refusées and the reason text is rendered on the card. (7) Empty state on Nouvelles reads 'Aucune nouvelle commande.' after last order is decided; tab counts show Nouvelles (1), Acceptées (1), Refusées (with no count when empty — expected per code `orders[t.key]?.length ? ...`). (8) Regression smoke: GET /admin/login 200, /menu 200, / 200 — no route breakage. (9) Cleanup: both test orders deleted via DELETE /api/admin/orders/{id} (both returned 200) and original opening hours restored via PUT /api/settings (200).
critical_code_review_comments: KitchenReceiptPrint.jsx: single module-level `activeIframe` is fine for the tablet's single-order-at-a-time UX, but if two accept clicks fire in rapid succession the first iframe is aggressively removed before its print dialog opens on some Android WebViews. Non-blocking — the accept button is already disabled via busyIds while the request is inflight, so the risk window is small.

The 30-second fallback cleanup timer will always fire even if `afterprint` fires early — currently harmless because `done` guard makes it idempotent, but the setTimeout handle is never cleared, so a stale closure retains the iframe reference for 30s per print. Negligible memory pressure but worth a `const t = setTimeout(...); iframe.__t = t;` + `clearTimeout(iframe.__t)` in cleanup.

Kitchen.jsx line ~127: reminder-beep effect depends only on `orders.new.length` — good; but `soundOnRef.current` is read inside the interval so toggling sound off (not currently supported in UI) would silently keep the interval alive doing nothing. Non-issue today since there is no 'disable sound' path.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The hidden-iframe print regression fix is verified working in the browser layer: iframe is appended to <body>, no CSS from the dark app theme can leak in (own <style> block), and the iframe is cleaned up (afterprint fires in Chromium headless within <2s). Physical thermal-printer verification on the SUNMI tablet is the ONLY thing not covered here — that's the user's manual test as noted in the request. If future changes touch KitchenReceiptPrint.jsx or Kitchen.jsx's accept/reprint handlers, re-run this iteration's playwright script — it directly asserts the appendChild/removeChild counts and console cleanliness which is the tightest possible headless-browser proxy for 'the print pipeline did not throw'.
rca of the issue: N/A — fix is verified working. Original regression root cause (per problem statement): the working @media print CSS in index.css was accidentally deleted mid-refactor while migrating to a hidden-iframe print approach; the migration was left half-done, so window.print() rendered the app's dark-theme body (white text on dark bg) with no @media print overrides, producing a blank white receipt on thermal paper. Main agent's fix: fully complete the iframe migration — printKitchenReceipt() now writes a standalone HTML doc with its own inline <style> (black text on white background, 80mm layout) into a hidden iframe and calls iframe.contentWindow.print(), so no ancestor CSS can ever bleed into the print output. Verified: no console errors, iframe is created and destroyed cleanly, and all tab transitions work.
